concept: CloudHSM: customer-controlled single-tenant FIPS 140-2 Level 3 HSM
tests: Choosing a service when keys must never leave a single-tenant HSM and only the company controls them.
expected: AWS CloudHSM: dedicated single-tenant HSM, FIPS 140-2 Level 3, keys under the customer's exclusive control. Triggers: "FIPS 140-2 Level 3", "exclusive control", "dedicated hardware".
why_not: KMS AWS managed keys are multi-tenant, not exclusive; SSE-S3 and Secrets Manager give no HSM control.
